The trade you missed is still costing you — and it closed hours ago.

You weren't in it, so it can't have hurt you. And yet it's the only one you're still thinking about, and the next three decisions will be made by that feeling. The missed trade didn't cost you its profit. It cost you the discipline on the following three.
